settings.heading: Handcrafted in India
settings.text: At Inlayora, we create timeless handcrafted furniture and décor that blends traditional craftsmanship with modern design. Each piece is carefully made by skilled artisans using premium materials like bone inlay, resin, and wood, bringing elegance, detail, and uniqueness into every space.

settings.heading: How each piece is made
settings.text: Each piece is individually handmade by skilled artisans using natural wood. Due to the handcrafted process and natural wood grain variations, every piece is unique and may have slight differences from the photos.

settings.title: Handmade from mango wood
settings.text: A sturdy mango wood border, shaped and joined by hand.

settings.title: Artwork set into every piece
settings.text: Printed and inlay patterns, from marble swirls to geometric designs.

settings.title: Sealed for everyday use
settings.text: A protective lacquer coating gives a water-resistant, high-gloss finish.

settings.title: Made by hand
settings.text: Every piece is crafted by skilled artisans, never mass-produced.

settings.title: Premium materials
settings.text: Bone inlay, resin and wood, chosen for detail and durability.

settings.title: One of a kind
settings.text: Natural grain means no two pieces are exactly alike.

settings.title: Made for you
settings.text: Custom sizes and prints on request.
